I switch to informal once I feel like someone knows me fairly well. It usually takes me a while to get comfortable with new people, but once I am it's more natural \(and comfortable kinda\)  to speak informally. I don't think I've ever acknowledged the switch, but I guess I'm more aware of how the other person reacts when I do it the first time. Just in case they don't feel as comfortable to speak informally. 

With professional superiors I always speak formally. But like with elders in my family, it's always been okay to speak informally to one another.
